AdditionalTabsDescription: Add extra tabs to this actor type's sheet, each with its own name. Each tab holds a repeatable list of named, richly-formatted notes, just like Notes did before.
ActorTypesDescription: Add, edit, and/or remove different actor types used in your game. Changing the actor type order will change the order that they appear in the dropdown when creating a new actor.
ActorTypesNote: Many actor setting changes can be updated from the actor sheet, however many of the values will not be updated, especially default values. This is to prevent values entered by players from being lost
CannotDeleteParentActorType: This actor type cannot be removed while other actor types are derived from it. Remove those first.
CantReadImportFile: Could not read the imported JSON file.
ConfirmImportMessage: Importing this settings file will replace all your current settings! If you want to keep your current settings, be sure to export them first!
ConfirmResetPlotPointUsesMessage: Resetting will replace the entire Plot Point Uses list with the default list!
ConfirmResetSettingsMessage: Resetting to default settings will replace all your current settings! If you want to keep your current settings, be sure to export them first!
ConsumableDiceDescription: Consumable dice are dice that may be depleted as they are used, e.g. resources. When the user tries to add the die to the pool they will be prompted to choose which dice assigned to that trait are to be added, along with a checkbox, prechecked, that asks if the chosen dice should be removed from the trait.
CustomRuleSetHint: Enables a custom rule set with its own dedicated configuration dialog.
DefaultSectionsDescription: Sections added here are given to every actor of this type the next time they click Update Settings on their sheet — but only if they don't already have a section with the same name. Existing sections, and their content, are never replaced.
DoomPoolActorHint: Only Actors with All Players ownership of Limited or Observer are shown in this list.
DoomPoolSettingsH: Choose which Actor represents the Doom Pool.
DicePoolInvalidDuplicateTrait: The trait "{trait}" has been added to the pool more than once.
DicePoolInvalidLimitOne: Too many dice from the "{traitSet}" Trait Set have been added to the pool: {traits}.
DicePoolInvalidMutuallyExclusive: The pool contains dice from mutually exclusive Trait Sets "{traitSetA}" ({traitsA}) and "{traitSetB}" ({traitsB}).
DerivedActorTypeDescription: Everything shown here belongs to the parent actor type and is read only. You can add your own Trait Sets, Traits, Simple Traits, Additional Tabs and Default Sections on top of it.
DerivedActorTypesDescription: Create actor types that inherit everything from this one. A derived actor type shows the parent's settings as read only and stays in step with them, while adding extras of its own. A derived actor type cannot itself be derived from.
ExtraEffectDieCheckbox: Spend a Plot Point to use an extra effect die
ExtraTotalDieCheckbox: Spend a Plot Point to add an extra rolled die result to your total
GroupChampionRemoved: The target holder was removed — no target until the GM restarts or clears the challenge
HasLabelsDescription: The intended purpose of labels is for user/player custom naming, such as distinctions or relationships. For example, a relationship trait with the name of "Saved my life" which requires the player to apply a name, would use a label to do so.
HitchActionStepUpDoomDie: Step up a die in the {doomPool}
HitchesApplyFailed: The selected hitch outcomes could not be applied. See the console for details.
ImportSuccessMessage: Your settings import has been successful!
ImportExportSettingsHint: Import or Export this game's settings.
ImportVersionWarning: The imported settings Cortex Prime version does not match the current Cortex Prime version being used.
Label: Label
MageMagicalPowerTraitRequired: Magical rolls must include a Power trait; the GM marked this as a magical roll.
MageNonMagicalPowerTraitInvalid: Non-Magical rolls cannot include a Power trait; the GM must mark this as a magical roll.
MageSettingsHint: Configure the Actor Types and Traits used by the Mage: The Ascension Engine custom rule set.
MissingActorTypeMessage: Cannot update. This actor type has been removed from the settings.
Name: Name
NoDistinctionActorLinked: No Distinction Actor linked to this scene
NoTraitsInPool: There are currently no traits or dice in this pool.
ParadoxApplyFailed: The Paradox outcome could not be applied. See the console for details.
PlayerCharacterActorType: Actor Type for a Player Character
PlotPointUsesSettingsH: Configure the list of reasons a Plot Point can be spent.
PresetTraitsDescription: The name, order, and checkbox settings of these preset traits can be updated from the actor sheet after changing it here. Users will be able to create custom traits to this trait set when editing them in the actor sheet.
ResetSuccessMessage: Your settings has been successfully reset to the default settings!
RollResultSourceCollapsedHint: Roll result die sources initially collapsed in chat.
RollUndoFailed: The roll could not be undone. See the console for details.
RollUndoUnavailable: This roll can no longer be undone.
RollUndoneMessage: {name}'s roll was undone by the GM — they may roll again.
SaveSettingsNote: Close and reopen character sheets to see saved changes.
SelectedDiceDescription: Selected dice colors are used for selecting dice in the Roll & Select option of the Dice Pool.
SettingsMessage: Please visit Foundry's Settings menu > Configure Settings > System Settings to get your game set up! There you can set up multiple character sheets for the various types of characters in your game. You may import some game settings or customize your own and even export them for another game!
SimpleTraitsDescription: These traits would appear in the sidebar of the traits tab, usually label and counters or label and dice combinations. Useful for things like Life Points, Hero Dice, Scale Die, etc.
SpendPlotPointExtraDieCheckbox: Spend a Plot Point to add two dice from a single trait set to your pool before you roll
SpotlightEnabledHint: Show the Spotlight control on the floating panel, letting the GM highlight which player character currently has the spotlight.
SubTraitsDescription: Sub-Traits are used for simple name and dice traits assigned to other traits. They are great for power traits, trait stress, skill specialization, etc.
TestModeSelectDiceValuesHint: When enabled, right-click a die in the Roll & Select dialog to override its rolled value — useful for testing specific outcomes (Hitches, Botches, exact Totals). Everything downstream (Total, Effect Dice, the chat card, and the recorded roll) uses the overridden value. Leave disabled for normal play.
ThemeSettingsH: Configure the theme for this game.
TraitSetsSettingDescription: Add or edit trait sets for this actor type. Each trait set has settings for its own traits. The name, order, and checkbox settings of these trait sets can be updated from the actor sheet after changing it here. All of the trait sets will appear in the main section of a character sheet in the traits tab.
TraitSettingsDescription: These settings may be updated from the actor sheet and would be applied to the preset traits as well as the custom traits.
UnlockedDescription: Unlocked is used to indicate if the character has access to the SFX. If it is not unlocked the "bullet" will be an unfilled circle and the text of the SFX will be faded.
WelcomeTitle: Welcome to the Cortex Prime System!
WelcomSeenHint: Pops up a brief tutorial message on first load of a world with this system
